The engram is on Naragun, north-west of the fairy ring , all the way up the floating steps, inside the ruins of Guthix's house.
Naragun is permanently accessible after completion of The World Wakes; alternatively, it may be accessed once during Desperate Times or Extinction.
sc: It is given by Orla Fairweather to the player during the tutorial for the activity.
Harmony of Naragun is the benefit of this engram, when active Guthixian butterflies will spawn instead of chronicle fragments.
Only one Guthixian butterfly can be present at a time; if you already have a Guthixian butterfly spawned and present, a chronicle fragment will spawn.
It was obtainable from Solomon's General Store.
It is a possible reward from opening medium reward caskets as part of the Treasure Trails Distraction and Diversion, or from cremating at the Columbarium.
Trimmed adamant armour cannot be made with the Smithing skill, nor can it be trimmed by any players.
It can be made into 10 Sundering strike (adept bloodrager) scrolls by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 0.

Anniversary Adventurer Bundle.x: The Anniversary Adventurer Bundle is a cosmetic override pack that can be purchased from the Marketplace for 500 RuneCoins for free-to-play players and 450 RuneCoins for members.

sc: Apmeken's Favour is a quest item obtained during Eclipse of the Heart after helping Apmeken.
It one of the four favours to be found in search of the fragment of Tumeken.
The shadow-dyed Ascension crossbow is made by dyeing an Ascension crossbow with Shadow dye.
The Bernie Halo appearance token is a unlock token awarded to Fresh Start Accounts that unlock the Bernie pet during the Fresh Start Worlds gamemode.
The token can be traded, once, directly to another player (it is not available on the Grand Exchange).
After doing the quest, this book can be found in the bookcase in your house, but it is titled "Book of Binding" instead of "Binding Book".

Black heraldic armour set 5 (lg).x: Black heraldic armour set 5 (lg) is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

sc: The blue rectangle key is a key found in Daemonheim while training the Dungeoneering skill.
Only one blue rectangle key can be found in a single dungeon.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 8 necronium bars and a necronium battleaxe + 2, requiring 1,920 progress to complete, granting a total of 4,000 Smithing experience.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 16 primal bars and a primal kiteshield + 3, requiring 3,080 progress to complete, granting a total of 22,400 Smithing experience.
A partially filled bucket of rubble is a quest item made by the player during the In Aid of the Myreque quest.
It is made by using an empty bucket on a pile of rubble in the basement of the bar in Burgh de Rott.

q: Bull roarer, used to summon Gujuo to bless more golden bowls
sc: It is obtained by giving a complete map of Kharazi Jungle to a forester just outside the Kharazi Jungle.
If lost, the bull roarer can be bought from any of the foresters in exchange for a cooked oomlie wrap.

Cabaret Jacket.x: Cabaret Jacket is a torso slot cosmetic override that is part of the Cabaret set.

sc: The Catalyst mithril trophy is a reward from Catalyst League.
It is earned at 20,000 League points and is awarded to the nominated account at the end of the league.
However, it does not affect charms obtained from non-combat sources, such as hunting charming moths or pickpocketing Amlodd workers.
Furthermore, this effect also does not work for charms received from the Arch-Glacor nor Bork.

Circus (Audience) Shoes.x: The Circus (Audience) Shoes are a feet slot cosmetic override that can be obtained through Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza as part of the Circus (Audience) outfit. They are unlocked alongside their item version.

sc: Clue scroll (medium) is a coordinate clue obtained from medium sealed clue scrolls.
Dark Romancer Attire (Blood Red) is a cosmetic override outfit that can be unlocked through the Gifts from the Heart promotion from Treasure Hunter.

Death Bringer Boots.x: The Death Bringer Boots are a feet slot cosmetic override that is part of the Death Bringer Vestments outfit. They can be unlocked by purchasing the Death Reaper Vestments Set. They are an upgraded version of the Death Seeker Boots, unlocked by completing 10 Slayer assignments while having any Death Seeker cosmetic active.

sc: Dimies the sardine is Gertrude's pet sardine, found on the of her house in the south-west part of New Varrock.
Dwayne is a companion pet that is unlocked by purchasing the Devourer Pack or Devourer bundle.
The early bird tome is a book received after completing Some Like It Cold in the 2 weeks following its release.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 16 elder rune bars and an elder rune pickaxe + 3, requiring 2,800 progress to complete, granting a total of 16,000 Smithing experience.

Elemental (Stoneheart) Gauntlets.x: Elemental (Stoneheart) Gauntlets is a hands slot cosmetic override that is part of the Elemental (Stoneheart) set.

sc: The fenris wolf pelt is a quest item obtained by killing a fenris wolf during the Fur 'n Seek quest.
The player must prepare the hide using a bag of salt to obtain a scrubbed fenris wolf pelt.
The Flo Bunny appearance token is a token unlock item that can be randomly obtained by redeeming a Skill Pet Bunny appearance token or by opening a mystery egg.
Fremennik boots can be bought from Yrsa's Shoe Store in Rellekka for 650 coins after completing the The Fremennik Trials.
They can also be obtained from Managing Miscellania by putting workers in the fishing area.
A gilded bench flatpack can be made at a workbench (Bench with vice or better) in the workshop of a player-owned house.

Group Ironman boots 4.x: Group Ironman boots 4 is a feet slot cosmetic override that is part of the Group Ironman armour 4.

Hardy gout tubers are obtained during the My Arm's Big Adventure quest from Murcaily.
A single tuber is given to the player after obtaining 60% favour, but is immediately replaced a handful of tubers by Murcaily after My Arm goes on a rampage.
Hexer's Wings is a wings slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked through the Potion Pandemonium promotion on Treasure Hunter.
The House Drakan top is tier 70 hybrid bodywear obtained during The Lord of Vampyrium.

Illuminated god book (override).x: The illuminated god book is a cosmetic override for shields and magic off-hand weapons. It is unlocked by completing illuminated god books, with each completed god book unlocking the respective recolour option.

sc: It is obtained by using the brass hand of Brass Hand Harry on an ink pad.
If it is destroyed after completion it cannot be re-obtained from Harry.

tx:
With Runecrafting level 13, mud runes are crafted from pure essence and either water runes and a water talisman at the Earth altar or earth runes and an earth talisman to the Water altar. The water or earth runes must be used on the opposite altar to craft the combination mud rune, for selecting the imbue option on the altar performs regular runecrafting. The respective talisman is consumed in the runecrafting process. However, a talisman is not consumed if using the Magic Imbue Lunar spell.
Combination runecrafting has a 50% success rate, yet a binding necklace enables a 100% success rate. Players receive 9.3 experience for combining earth runes at the Water altar and 9.5 for combining water runes at the Earth Altar.

sc: The novite gauntlets is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.

r: Partial completion of Dealing with Scabaras
sc: It can be made by using a bucket of Ugthanki dung on a bronze platelegs while standing in the Kharidian Desert.
The ability to make the tablet is unlocked with rank 4 reputation in the Port district.
It may then be made from 1 soft clay and 2 law runes at any lectern in a player-owned house.
Protoleather boots is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.
A pumpkin trees token is an item obtained during the 2023 Halloween event from Smashing Pumpkins and Party Pumpkins.
Rainbow Pot of Gold is a cosmetic override for magic off-hand weapons that can be unlocked by redeeming a pot of gold token, available on Treasure Hunter during the Rainbow's End promotion.
The red pentagon is an item used in The Prisoner of Glouphrie created by using a minute crystal seed on the singing bowl.
Relomia's message is given to the player by Relomia to start Sliske's Endgame.

Replica Barrows (Dharok) Helm.x: The Replica Barrows (Dharok) Helm is a head slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Replica Barrows (Dharok) outfit.

sc: A rune satchel is a drop from newtroosts in the Creature Creation activity.
Other colours of satchels are available from the Creature Creation minigame.
The sacred clay robe bottom is a reward from the Stealing Creation minigame.
Sapphire bolts can be created through the Fletching skill.
It can be found by searching the crate in the ruins south of Raz's hut.
Sheratan Mace is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 34 of Zodiyak Track.
It is made by dyeing a sirenic hauberk with Third Age dye.
It can be made with the Cooking skill at level 59, granting 479 experience per batch.
It could be unlocked through the Slime is of the Essence event.

sc: The small Phoenix lamp is an experience lamp obtainable from the Phoenix Lamps and Phoenix Rising promotions.
The following is an experience table detailing the number of experience received from a small Phoenix lamp for any given skill level without bonus experience.
It is made by using a Summoning pouch on a Summoning obelisk with 151 spirit shards, a blue charm, and a jug of water in the backpack, requiring 55 Summoning and giving 484 experience.
It can be made into ten Spirit Jelly scrolls (Dissolve) by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 5.
They can be obtained by breeding any species of spider between 09:00-21:00 game time or checking a spider egg.
The ice-dyed staff of Sliske is made by dyeing a staff of Sliske with ice dye.
The stone block is an item found while Dungeoneering.
To obtain a stone block, a player must enter the puzzle room with three statues or the puzzle room with ten statues, and mine a stone block from the crumbling wall.

tx:
Players may use the pyre logs, along with a set of shade remains (Loar, Phrin or Riyl), on one of the numerous funeral pyres located to the south and to the west of Mort'ton's centre. The pyre can then be lit, which releases the shade and rewards Firemaking and Prayer experience, as well as some coins or a key. The type of key rewarded solely depends on the type of remains that are cremated, and do not depend on the logs used.
After the Legacy of Seergaze quest, these may also be used to cremate vyre corpses in the Columbarium under Paterdomus temple.
sc: To make teak pyre logs, players must first obtain some sacred olive oil.
Once the sacred oil has been obtained players will need to use three doses of it upon some teak logs.

The Minister.x: The Minister is a miniature version of The Magister that can be unlocked as a pet with a soul fragment, which can be obtained as a drop from killing The Magister.

sc: This is a unique gold bar, and Og will not accept a gold bar created by normal use of the Smithing skill.
It can be made into 10 Second wind (wise worldbearer) scrolls by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 0.
The witch skirt is a holiday reward from the 2008 Halloween event.
Yellow dye is a dye made by taking 2 onions and 5 coins to Aggie or Rana the dyer.
It can also be bought at Lletya Seamstress for 6 coins.
The Zaryte fragments are items obtained by defeating Nex with necromancy after accepting Kili's Knowledge VI (power) task.
